verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no documented public API for Replit's core features (create app, publish, database, deployments); the openapi probe explicitly returned 404 on all candidate endpoints, and all cited docs describe UI/Agent-driven workflows (chat-based agent, publish button, dashboard toggles) rather than programmatic API parity. MCP integration lets Agent call external tools, but that is the reverse direction (Replit calling out) not an API for driving Replit itself.
